rdf:Description.skos:prefLabel: Define Behavior for Ambiguous Node Structures
rdf:Description.skos:description: This ticket requires input from the human staff to define the desired behavior of the system when encountering ambiguous node structures in the Draw.io XML. The current parser assumes a specific structure for individual nodes (a parent cell with an identifier and a child cell with a RiC-O class).
rdf:Description.skos:scopeNote:
**Context:** The parser needs to know how to handle nodes that do not conform to the expected structure. This decision will affect the robustness and flexibility of the parser.
**Question:** How should the system handle nodes that do not follow this structure?
**Please select one of the following options by editing this file and replacing "[ ]" with "[x]":** [ ] a) Ignore the node and log a warning. [ ] b) Raise an error and stop the parsing process. [ ] c) Attempt to infer the structure based on a set of predefined rules.
**If you selected (c), please provide the rules for inference below:** ``` <your rules here> ```
rdf:Description.skos:changeNote: **Implementation Plan (for Agent):** 1. **Await Human Input:** - Wait for the human staff to edit this file and make a selection. 2. **Implement Chosen Behavior:** - Based on the selection, implement the corresponding logic in the `DrawIOParser` class. - If (a), add logging for ignored nodes. - If (b), raise a specific exception (e.g., `InvalidNodeStructureError`). - If (c), implement the inference logic based on the provided rules.
